question: What dark form is contemplated after resorting to the place of the yogini?
premises: One resorts to the place of the yogini.
The contemplated object is dark and black-colored.
inference: After resorting to the yogini's place, one contemplates a dark, black-colored form.
plain_english: Having resorted to the place of the yogini, one contemplates a dark, black-colored form.
